services.name: Private Lesson
services.desc: Once or ongoing, a Private Lesson can be a great way to learn new skills, fine-tune current skills, or focus deeply on specific aspects of your training. Private lessons are intended for one to six students. By booking a personalized class at SANCA, you can choose who is in your class, when the class happens, what circus activities you want to practice, and even who your coach is. If you are hoping to book a Flying Trapeze lesson, click here instead of filling out this form! SANCA is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization committed to serving students from all economic backgrounds by providing youth scholarships. Tax ID
